placements.role: Produces the PAC-3 seeker at Huntsville, Alabama as subcontractor to the interceptor prime, and is tripling that capacity under a multi-year framework.

role_evidence.claim: Boeing announced a seven-year framework with the U.S. Department of War to triple production of PAC-3 seekers, and said it has invested more than $200 million since 2024 to expand PAC-3 seeker production capacity in Huntsville, Alabama.
role_evidence.source_name: Boeing news release: Boeing and Department of War Sign 7-Year Framework to Expand PAC-3 Seeker Production
role_evidence.source_excerpt: Boeing and the U.S. Department of War (DOW) have agreed to a seven-year framework to triple production of PAC-3 seekers to meet global demand for air and missile defense. Boeing has invested more than $200 million since 2024 to expand PAC-3 seeker production capacity in Huntsville, Alabama, including a 35,000-square-foot facility expansion.
